details:
TerraTwin – Planetary Analogue Intelligence Platform

TerraTwin is a web-based platform designed to help researchers explore and compare Earth locations that may serve as environmental analogues for future Moon and Mars missions.

The application provides an interactive satellite map, candidate-location exploration, planetary environment comparisons, a similarity-ranking engine, and report generation. Users can examine candidate locations, compare environmental and terrain-related characteristics, and rank locations against selected lunar and Martian reference profiles.

TerraTwin aims to make planetary analogue exploration more accessible through an integrated, interactive interface. Identifying relevant Earth analogues can support preliminary mission planning, research preparation, and the study of environmental challenges associated with future planetary exploration.

The platform was developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, MapLibre GL, Python, and FastAPI. The frontend is hosted on Vercel and the backend on Render. Mapping uses Esri World Imagery and OpenFreeMap.

The current prototype uses illustrative sample feature values and reference profiles. These are clearly distinguished from actual NASA observations and are intended to demonstrate the platform's comparison and ranking workflow.
